footer: Report every mission, pass or fail, on GitHub, and send the wallet's report from Settings → Report a problem with every bug. New missions every Monday morning; weekly call on Fridays.

starter.title: Create your wallet
starter.task: Accept the beta agreement, pick a look (Modern or DGen), and create a wallet. Write your 24 recovery words on paper (never a photo) and pass the word check. Stay on the screen while it secures your phone.

starter.title: Make your card
starter.task: Add your name, email and phone to your contact card. In Modern, add a photo and a banner and frame them. Check that Receive shows your code as a QR and written out in full.

starter.title: Add three testers
starter.task: Add each other: each person scans the other's code from Receive, or pastes the code they were sent. Link one contact to someone in your phone's contacts.

starter.title: Pair over Bluetooth
starter.task: Phones close together, Bluetooth on, app open on People (Modern) or Contacts (DGen). Each contact should show "Paired". Note how long it took.

starter.title: Get test ERA
starter.task: Claim from Tokens → Faucet, then make your second claim. Time both, from tap to balance. Was the second faster, and by how much? Any glitches?

starter.title: Send and receive
starter.task: Five payments with your contacts, both directions, each with a note. Each one should leave once and arrive once, with the same amount and note on both phones.

starter.title: Switch looks
starter.task: In Settings, try Modern and DGen, dark and light, and Simple mode on and off. Balances, contacts and history must match in every look.

starter.title: Connect Wildstate
starter.task: Install and open Wildstate, then connect it to your DSM wallet: scan the game's code from the wallet, or tap OPEN DSM WALLET on the same phone. Approve it. Time how long it took.

starter.title: Find the bulletin board
starter.task: Walk to the notice board in the camp garden by the scarecrow and read it. Every week's missions are pinned there, with a COPY ALL button.

missions.title: A first catch
missions.task: Get three free capsules from the scarecrow, then catch and name a creature in the meadow. It should show in the wallet's Objects.

missions.title: Fish
missions.task: Cast at the pond's edge and catch a water creature.

missions.title: Kill it mid-payment
missions.task: Force-close the app the moment you tap Send now. Nothing may be lost or doubled.

missions.title: Buy from Bramble
missions.task: Buy capsules paid from your wallet. Then buy again and force-close the game the moment you pay: paid once, given once.

missions.title: Cut the network
missions.task: Airplane mode right after Send now. You should see a clear message or a finished payment, never a half state.

missions.title: Sell a creature
missions.task: Sell one to Bramble. It leaves your wallet's Objects and the WILD arrives.

missions.title: Restart and walk away
missions.task: Restart the phone during and after payments, and leave the app in the background for an hour.

missions.title: Beat a trainer
missions.task: Win against Kade or Nessa. The WILD bounty should land in your wallet.

missions.title: Interrupt setup
missions.task: On a spare phone, leave the app while setup secures the phone. It should start cleanly again.

missions.title: Pick up where you left off
missions.task: Close the game mid-way and reopen it, then open it on another phone with the same wallet.

missions.title: Lock your wallet
missions.task: Set a PIN, leave and come back. Careful: after three wrong tries only your recovery phrase opens it.

missions.title: Recover onto a new phone
missions.task: If you have a DSM recovery ring: back up to it, then restore on a second phone. The old phone must stop paying.

missions.title: Create your own token
missions.task: Create a token, send it out, have contacts pass it on. The total must never change.

missions.title: Trade WILD
missions.task: In the market, swap WILD for ERA and back. Both settle in your wallet as quoted.

missions.title: Adopt a token
missions.task: A contact adds your token with Tokens → Add Token, using its policy anchor.

missions.title: Gift a creature
missions.task: Send a creature from your wallet's Objects to a friend who plays. It should appear in their BAG.

missions.title: Collectibles
missions.task: Flip the Objects switch and send a one-of-a-kind object, like a creature, to a contact.

missions.title: Play a friend
missions.task: In the lobby, play a free match, then a staked one: each wallet locks its stake, the winner collects both.

missions.title: Trade
missions.task: In Trade, swap one token for another, then open and close a small liquidity position.

missions.title: See what is DSM
missions.task: Press DSM during play and check what ran on DSM and what only on the game server.

missions.title: Escrow vault
missions.task: Lock a small stake with a contact, set two outcomes, decide one and release it.

missions.title: Connect an app
missions.task: In Apps, scan an app's connect code, approve it, and use it. Anything you didn't approve must wait.
